# deep submerge

Deep submerge is a dark, low-contrast theme with cool, muted colors and subtle styling tweaks. It preserves a readable line length while respecting snippets that change width, such as wide view, and it offers dark mode only.

![deep submerge screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-deep-submerge/HEAD/images/deep-submerge-thumbnail.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "deep submerge"
    author: "incantatem2"
    repo:   "incantatem2/Obsidian-deep-submerge"
    slug:   "deep-submerge"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/deep-submerge"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-deep-submerge"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-deep-submerge/HEAD/images/deep-submerge-thumbnail.jpg"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a dark, low-contrast theme with cool, muted colors and subtle elegant styling tweaks. Preserve readable line length while respecting snippets that change width, such as wide view; dark-mode only."
}
```
